dedupe_keys.name: kth impact tested reinforced concrete beam images and sensor measurements

description: This dataset documents impact tests on small reinforced-concrete beams at KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm. The article describes eighteen beams subjected to a seventy-kilogram striker dropped from 2.4 metres, with different impact locations and transverse reinforcement. High-speed images at six kilohertz support digital image correlation, while force and acceleration channels were sampled at 19.2 kilohertz. Current Mendeley version 4 lists TIFF images, sixteen MATLAB data files and accompanying scripts and documentation, free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is controlled experiments on eighty-centimetre beams, with calendar test dates not established. Reduced scale, differing reinforcement and unverified correspondence between files and every reported test are limitations. Modellers could calibrate impact-response or shear-failure simulations using a structural tool such as model-opensees. No image, sensor array or script was downloaded, and no force reconstruction or finite-element validation was repeated.
